blocks.text:
# Quota report

The daily quotas shipped on **Tuesday**; this note sums up *what changed*, what ~~did not~~ and where to look.
A second line of the same paragraph joins the first, as CommonMark says.

## Changes

- The API counts each export
  - against the organisation's quota
    - reset at midnight UTC
- [x] backend merged
- [ ] front behind the `daily_quotas` flag

1. Ship the API
2. Ship the front
10. Watch the dashboards

> Quotas are per organisation, not per teammate.
> See https://example.com/quotas for the rules.

### Numbers

| Plan | Daily quota | Share |
|:-----|------------:|:-----:|
| Free | 10 | 62% |
| Pro | 200 | 30% |
| Enterprise | unlimited | 8% |

```rust
fn quota(plan: &str) -> Option<u32> {
    // Enterprise has none.
    match plan { "free" => Some(10), "pro" => Some(200), _ => None }
}
```

Escapes stay literal: 2 \* 3, \# not a heading, \[not a link\].

---
